name: Ring of Protection
description: While worn and attuned, this ring grants a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend up to 3 charges to cast Magic Missile. Each charge casts the spell one level higher, starting at level 1. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend its last charge, roll a d20; on a 1, the wand crumbles to ashes.

name: Sword of Vengeance
description: A cursed magic weapon that requires attunement. Attuning to it binds the curse to the wielder. While cursed, the wielder cannot voluntarily end attunement; Remove Curse can break that attunement.
